description: This file defines the LoanAccountLockRepository interface, which extends Spring Data JPA repositories for accessing and manipulating LoanAccountLock entities with custom query methods related to locking loan accounts.

classes.name: LoanAccountLockRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for LoanAccountLock entity with custom query methods for managing loan account locks.

methods.name: findByLoanIdAndLockOwner
methods.description: Finds an optional LoanAccountLock entity by loan ID and lock owner.

methods.name: deleteByLoanIdInAndLockOwner
methods.description: Deletes multiple LoanAccountLock entities based on a list of loan IDs and lock owner.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdIn
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LoanAccountLock entities for a list of loan IDs.

methods.name: existsByLoanIdAndLockOwner
methods.description: Checks if a lock exists for a given loan ID and lock owner.

methods.name: existsByLoanIdAndLockOwnerAndErrorIsNotNull
methods.description: Checks if a lock exists for a given loan ID and lock owner with a non-null error.

methods.name: removeLockByOwner
methods.description: Custom JPQL query to delete locks with specific conditions related to COB business date and error, for specific lock owners.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdInAndLockOwner
methods.description: Finds all loan account locks for a list of loan IDs and lock owner.
